sections.Profile:
The "Lucky Inning" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on May 8, 1950, is a single-player electro-mechanical game featuring artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Baseball, Sports, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Gordon Horlick
